title: Shared definitions for the fixture schemas (mirrors src/contracts/fixtures.ts)

instant.description: ISO 8601 instant with the fixed +07:00 offset (Instant in the contract).

demoSerial.description: Serial of a demo CA/TSA/OCSP/user certificate. DE:M0 marks it as fake; pairs are 0-9A-Z (the OCSP signer uses 'SP').

certSerial.description: Demo serial, or the single allow-listed untrusted serial '01' (D06 self-signed cert). Whether '01' is legal for a given cert is enforced in certs.schema.json (needs untrusted_fixture: true).

fingerprint.description: Fake SHA-256 fingerprint: DE:M0 followed by 30 more pairs = 32 colon-separated pairs.

docSha256.description: Fake document hash: 'de00' marker + 60 lowercase hex characters (assumption A24).
